baseline_models.mechanism: Totality scopes every knowable or reportable item; exhaustive numerical encompassing then renders that complete field as writing.

activation_trace.role: Totality and completeness make the scope exhaustive rather than representative.
The knowable and reportable thing supplies the individual object of reckoning.
Counting to full numerical and cognitive encompassment supplies the exhaustive operation.
Joined letters and the written document give the completed reckoning a durable textual form.

changed_reading.before: We counted everything in a book.
changed_reading.after: Every knowable or reportable item, without remainder, has been exhaustively reckoned and rendered as a written record.

baseline_models.mechanism: The completed count is not only retained information: the binding-decree branch of writing lets the resultative كتابا fix what has been reckoned as an enforceable determination.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive reckoning supplies the fully determined content.
Inscription as binding judgment or decree turns the reckoning into a fixed determination.

changed_reading.before: The count is preserved as information.
changed_reading.after: The exhaustive reckoning fixes its contents as a binding determination, not merely as remembered information.

baseline_models.mechanism: The register branch of كتاب converts the universal object from a quantity into a roster: each knowable item is included, and exhaustive counting certifies that no member is omitted.

activation_trace.role: Complete inclusion supplies the roster's no-exclusion scope.
Each knowable and reportable thing becomes a possible register entry.
Exhaustive counting verifies the register's completeness.
Enrollment into a register or group gives the count an inclusion and allotment function.

changed_reading.after: Each thing is individually enrolled in an all-inclusive register, so reckoning concerns membership and assignment as well as quantity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement from mutual questioning through a delivered report and divergent paths to disclosure activates the focus record as an answer-bearing settlement of contested knowledge.

activation_trace.role: A thing as knowable and reportable anchors the epistemic content in the focus object.
The written document supplies a stable answer to disputed speech.
Mutual questioning supplies the unresolved inquiry that the record can settle.
A report that arrives and is conveyed supplies the disputed informational object.
Parties taking unlike paths turns the report into an actual epistemic divergence.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the promised transition from dispute to knowledge.

structural_cues: 78:1-5 opens with inquiry, contested report, and the repeated prospect of knowing.
The focus record later follows the surah's explicit scene of denial in 78:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies questioning, report, divergence, disclosure, and a written knowable object; the reader supplies the arrow from those elements to the record as epistemic settlement. A live alternative is that the opening dispute concerns the event generally while the focus record serves only moral accounting.

changed_reading.after: The comprehensive written reckoning also functions as the stable evidentiary answer to the surah's opening dispute.

context_deltas.mechanism: A long catalogue of making culminates in the focus totality. Creation as bringing into a state, measuring, and building by joining parts activates كتاب as an inventory whose assembled form mirrors the ordered construction it records.

activation_trace.role: Complete encompassment closes the preceding catalogue without remainder.
Joining one thing to another lets the record assemble the created particulars into one ordered whole.
Causing a thing to become a specified state supplies deliberate ordering rather than a loose list.
Creation as measuring and proportioning makes later reckoning continuous with prior design.
Building by joining parts parallels the book's assembly of discrete entries.

structural_cues: 78:6-16 forms an itemized sequence of earth, mountains, pairs, sleep, night, day, heavens, lamp, rain, grain, growth, and gardens.
Repeated جعل in 78:6, 78:9-11, and 78:13 gives that sequence a shared making pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated making, creation as measurement, building by joining, and book as joining; the reader supplies the arrow that the later record mirrors the architecture of the made order. A live alternative is a purely retrospective ledger with no structural analogy to creation.

changed_reading.before: Every thing is later entered into a record.
changed_reading.after: The record gathers the surah's measured and assembled created order into a corresponding complete inventory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Judicial separation at an appointed time and the later command to undergo or experience the outcome activate كتاب as a decree with a schedule and an execution, not only a retrospective archive.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive reckoning supplies the determinate contents to be executed.
Writing as binding judgment supplies the decree stage of the mechanism.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood gives the decree its adjudicative function.
A struck or appointed time gives the determination a scheduled point of enactment.
Experiencing and undergoing a thing supplies the transition from inscription to lived consequence.

structural_cues: 78:17 declares the day of separation an appointed time.
The focus statement in 78:29 is immediately followed by the consequence command in 78:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjudicative separation, appointment, binding inscription, and experienced outcome; the reader supplies the temporal arrow from schedule to decree to enactment. A live alternative is that the book only verifies an outcome fixed independently of the record.

changed_reading.before: The book preserves a completed count.
changed_reading.after: The book is a timed and executable determination: exhaustive reckoning is fixed for adjudication and then made experiential.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recompense that answers an act, a measure equal to its counterpart, and explicit accounting turn exhaustive inscription into a calibration mechanism that matches consequence to what is recorded.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive counting supplies itemized measurement rather than a rough aggregate.
Binding inscription converts the measured contents into an adjudicative determination.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the action-to-outcome relation.
A measure equal to need or counterpart supplies proportional calibration.
Counting and account name the evaluative frame that the subjects failed to expect.

structural_cues: جزاء وفاقا in 78:26, refusal to expect حساب in 78:27, and the focus reckoning in 78:29 form a tight sequence.
78:30 converts that sequence into addressed consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, equivalence, account, exhaustive count, and binding inscription; the reader supplies the causal arrow that the record calibrates the match. A live alternative is that the book merely documents a proportional judgment produced elsewhere.

changed_reading.before: The verse records all relevant facts.
changed_reading.after: The verse describes an itemized adjudicative measure through which consequence is matched to act.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediate falsification of visible signs activates the knowable thing and written-book branches as an evidence-preserving counter-record that does not depend on the deniers' account.

activation_trace.role: The knowable and reportable thing makes each denied sign or claim eligible for evidentiary capture.
A written document gives the evidence persistence independent of current speech.
Contrariety to truth supplies the active denial that the record resists.
The visible mark supplies concrete evidence rather than an unanchored accusation.

structural_cues: The two K-Dh-B occurrences and the sign occurrence in 78:28 immediately precede the focus record.
The opening dispute and promised knowing keep truth-status active across the surah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible signs, falsehood, knowable objects, and writing; the reader supplies the arrow that the record preserves evidence against denial. A live alternative is a comprehensive record with no specifically polemical function.

changed_reading.before: The book is a neutral inventory.
changed_reading.after: The book is also a denial-resistant evidentiary record in which every sign and truth-claim remains inspectable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reward described as recompense, giving, and sufficiency activates the allotment-register branch of كتاب. The all-inclusive record can distribute and provide, so it is not restricted to a prosecution ledger.

activation_trace.role: Complete scope prevents the record from being narrowed to only the condemned side.
Enrollment in an official register or allotment makes the book distributive as well as documentary.
Recompense on the favorable side supplies the register's reward relation.
Giving and handing over supply actual distribution from the registered allotment.
Sufficiency and enrichment keep the reward from collapsing into bare debit-credit equivalence.

structural_cues: The focus lies between punitive جزاء in 78:26 and favorable جزاء and عطاء in 78:36.
حساب appears on both sides of the focus, in 78:27 and 78:36.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies favorable recompense, giving, sufficiency, total scope, and registration for allotment; the reader supplies the arrow from record to distribution. A live alternative is the counting branch of حساب, which would make the gift measured rather than sufficient or amplifying.

changed_reading.before: The record is primarily an indictment that supports punishment.
changed_reading.after: The all-inclusive register also enrolls and allots reward, allowing reckoning to issue in sufficient gift as well as exact liability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing scene of a person looking at what the hands advanced activates the focus book as an inspectable dossier of embodied agency rather than an inaccessible statement of omniscience.

activation_trace.role: Knowable and reportable items give the dossier inspectable contents.
Exhaustive itemization ensures that the person's manifested history has no missing entries.
The written document supplies the dossier form in which prior agency can be confronted.
Directed sight or insight supplies the act of confronting what has been preserved.
Advancing something ahead supplies the temporal deposit that later becomes present evidence.
What the two hands earn anchors the record's contents in performed agency.

structural_cues: 78:40 closes the surah with the person looking at what the hands sent ahead.
This final visual confrontation occurs after the focus claim of exhaustive written reckoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies looking, advance, hand-earned action, and exhaustive writing; the reader supplies the arrow that the focus record mediates the final inspection. A live alternative is direct manifestation of deeds without documentary mediation.

changed_reading.before: The exhaustive record is known only to its recorder.
changed_reading.after: The exhaustive record becomes a dossier the agent can confront, making each embodied deed visibly attributable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the pebble branch beneath a verbal form of counting and then materializes writing as assembly. It remains anchored in أَحْصَيْنَاهُ and كِتَابًا through packet branches; downstream prose should present it only as a word-image analogy, never as a replacement lexical translation.

activation_trace.role: Pebbles and the single pebble supply a material image for discrete tally units.
Joining one thing to another supplies assembly of the discrete units into a whole.
Totality makes the assembled tally complete rather than sampled.

changed_reading.after: Each thing can be imagined as a discrete pebble-like tally token joined into a complete documentary aggregate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts from linear writing to a spatial and ecological enclosure. It remains anchored in the surrounding-ring branch of كُلّ, the joining branch of كتاب, and the packet's interwoven and encircling context images; downstream prose should qualify it as a cross-domain model of completeness, not as the direct sense of كتاب.

activation_trace.role: A surrounding ring supplies a bounded image of total inclusion.
Joining parts supplies internal linkage within the enclosing whole.
Plants or trees wrapping into one another supply interwoven internal organization.
Encircling a thing supplies the boundary that keeps every included element within view.

changed_reading.before: The book is a linear list of entries.
changed_reading.after: The record can be modeled as an enclosing, interwoven whole whose boundary and internal joins leave no item outside.

strongest_changes: The creation catalogue turns abstract totality into an inventory mirroring a measured and assembled order.
جزاء وفاقا and حساب turn the record into a proportional adjudicative measure.
The immediate denial of signs turns writing into evidence that persists independently of contested speech.
The reward-side gift and sufficiency reopen the same register as distributive rather than exclusively punitive.
The final sight of hand-earned acts makes the exhaustive record potentially inspectable by the recorded agent.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made the compact focus sentence a hinge: it gathers the earlier created order and disputed signs, fixes the judgment that follows, and remains broad enough to support both liability and favorable allotment.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax and branch range of كِتَابًا leave written archive and binding determination simultaneously live.
حِسَابًا in 78:36 can activate counted measure or sufficiency, yielding materially different reward models.
The final viewing of deeds may be record-mediated or a direct manifestation independent of a document.
The pebble-token and enclosed-record models are analogical activations and should remain explicitly exploratory.
